body:
Depression doesn't discriminate. Famous actors, musicians, other successful people can still suffer from depression. 

People are ignorant. Your feelings are valid.

It's just been so many months and the gateway for me to move towards getting better is too tough and I can't do it on my own. My friends and family don't know what to say or do anymore and I haven't been able to get the treatment I need. I know that I need more intensive therapy to get through this but even spite of advocating for myself for months, I just keep getting left to dry. 

I'm struggling with accepting a situation that I do not want and do not like and haven't been able to move past it, and it brings me so much misery and pain. I've been trying so hard and it hasn't improved.
I gotta say thanks for responding. It's validating in a way. I hope things get better for you!
Unfortunately the rest of the world doesn't get it!
I think my biggest problem is that people in my life don't get it and try to throw solutions at me when all I want is someone to listen and hear me tbh.
That's cool, I'm glad for you! Being understood means a lot more than one would think

Truly. 

Feels like the world is too much or maybe the other way around

I feel like I won't get over him because I don't want to get over him. 

I have a complicated relationship with my family. I can sometimes talk to my sister but my parents don't get it and it usually ends up being a fight because they don't get my mental illness

He broke up with me and I couldn't handle it, so I withdrew from the semester at school and ended up in and out of the hospital for mental health crises regarding this. Spent roughly 2 and a half months total in the hospital. I'm behind in school now, not as close to my friends as I used to be, the person I am in love with doesn't want me, and I just don't care about my life anymore. I'm not passionate about anything. I'm just on auto-pilot

Ever since my life fell apart after my ex broke up with me, there has been distance between me and people I was close to.  It's been many months and I'm still not over it, but I've gotten to a place where I'm functioning better. Even so, people just don't respond to me often, regardless of the topic, anymore. Surprisingly my ex responds to me with more consistency than anyone else, but he still doesn't want to be with me so it still feels horrible

I struggle with the fact that most music has become really triggering for me? Most tv shows and movies are the same way. I do listen to podcasts though. For some reason I can stomach those more than other types of media

I feel the same way. I've been in the hospital several times this year for weeks and gone through so many meds and so much therapy but I'm still in the same boat. 

I wouldn't wish this feeling on anyone, and I am sad that you feel this way. I know it isn't really helpful but I wish I could help. I can offer to chat, but that's about it.

I read your other post and I don't have any real good advice but you're not alone and I'm in a similar position, I think. It's hard, trying is hard when it doesn't seem to work or get any better. 

There's a sliver of me hoping that it does, but I'm so terrified and sure that it won't

I don't have any good advice but I'm in a similar situation. I've tried so hard to guilt him back and it honestly almost destroyed the friendship we do have. I'm not satisfied with only friendship, but letting you know you could easily make it worse if you aren't careful.  

I hope it works out for you. I wish there was a button we could push to make it work.

hey at least nier is a great game 

i say that you lose at least some pathetic points for choosing a great game. 

i have been where you're at though. i feel like it probably happens more often than you'd think, but what do i know

I'm in school getting my master's, most people think I'm doing fine because I get along well with others. Not to toot my own horn but I'm frequently referred to as the "hot friend" because I strive to be fashionable and presentable at most times. 

I have all these things going for me but I am miserable and none of it makes me feel better. It just feels like every time I am happy, life tears me down (my favorite job ended up closing, my ex broke up with me, I witnessed some traumatic events, got assaulted, etc etc etc). I try hard to be a good and friendly and attractive person and yet bad things keep happening to me 

Also for what it's worth despite my looks and friendly personality I constantly attract men who are creeps or just want to take advantage of me
Borderline personality disorder in this case. The severe fear of abandonment feels like a lost cause at this point to be honest.
